title: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.50% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?
html:
Market · Kalshi

Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.50% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?

Open
Midpoint53¢BookYes bid 21¢ · Ask 85¢Depth$364ClosesApr 28, 2027Settled byFederal Reserve Board of Governors (https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm)

Asks

  • The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting
Rules

If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 4.50% following the Federal Reserve's Apr 28, 2027 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.

This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Apr 28, 2027 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.
